name: Shop: finds the right article when search ranked it last of eight
description: An online shop's help center returns eight passages, and the one that answers the question comes last. Retrieval order is a hint, not the answer: the draft must use and cite the return-label article and none of the others.

input.subject: Return label
input.body: Hi, I want to send back the boots from order #5521. How do I get a return label?

knowledge.title: Shipping times
knowledge.content: Standard shipping takes 3 to 7 business days. Express shipping arrives in 1 to 2 business days.

knowledge.title: Order tracking
knowledge.content: Every order gets a tracking link by email once it ships. The link also appears on the Orders page.

knowledge.title: Changing an order
knowledge.content: You can change the size or delivery address within 2 hours of placing an order.

knowledge.title: Gift cards
knowledge.content: Gift cards never expire and can be used on any order, including sale items.

knowledge.title: Size guide
knowledge.content: Our boots run half a size small. If you are between sizes, choose the larger one.

knowledge.title: Payment methods
knowledge.content: We accept cards, PayPal and Apple Pay. Cards are charged when the order ships.

knowledge.title: Store pickup
knowledge.content: Orders marked for pickup are held at the store for 7 days.

knowledge.title: Return labels
knowledge.content: To return an item, open the order on the Orders page and choose Return items. A prepaid return label is emailed to you within 1 hour. Returns are free within 30 days of delivery.

mock.text:
Hi Ana, open order #5521 on the Orders page and choose Return items. We'll email you a prepaid return label within an hour, and returns are free within 30 days of delivery.

Best,
